tax.text: Rogers supported the 2017 tax law, which reduced individual and business tax rates, and says he supports a simpler, flatter tax code.
tax.quote: It reduced tax rates for individuals and businesses alike, allowing the average American to keep more of their hard-earned money

wages.text: Rogers opposed a proposal to raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour, saying it could cost jobs.
wages.quote: they doubled-down on efforts to advance this bad policy and destroy 1.4 million jobs in the process.

trade.text: Rogers urged the Treasury Department to designate China a currency manipulator and supported legislation enabling countervailing duties against unfair trade practices.
trade.quote: Commerce can't levy counter-veiling duties unless Treasury registers China as a 'currency manipulator'

debt.text: Rogers cosponsored and voted for the Social Security Fairness Act, which increased benefits for some retirees.
debt.quote: I have cosponsored this bill for many years and tirelessly pushed for its passage

schools.text: He voted for the Scholarships for Opportunity and Results Act, which reauthorized the D.C. opportunity scholarship program.
schools.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Scholarships for Opportunity and Results Act

safety.text: Rogers secured federal funding for police departments and fire services in Eastern Kentucky.
safety.quote: I was honored to secure additional funding for the Pikeville Police Department and the Louisa Fire Department

immigration.text: Rogers says he opposes amnesty for undocumented immigrants and supports increased border patrol, surveillance, and penalties for smuggling.
immigration.quote: I have consistently opposed amnesty for illegal immigrants and, instead, supported legislation that seeks to end the practice

guns.text: Rogers backed appropriations provisions barring the Justice Department from consolidating firearms sales records or retaining records of people who passed background checks.
guns.quote: Made into permanent law three provisions that protect the right to keep and bear arms

abortion.text: He voted against the Women's Health Protection Act and called for protection of every life.
abortion.quote: Every life should be protected and valued, not violently discarded.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He supported legislation requiring school athletics to recognize reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
gender.quote: school athletics comply with Title IX recognition of a person's reproductive biology and genetics at birth.

cannabis.text: Rogers voted against the MORE Act, which would have removed marijuana from the federal controlled-substances list.
cannabis.quote: Congressman Hal Rogers voted against the bill, citing its disregard for science and the nation's drug abuse epidemic.

health.text: Rogers opposed a Senate health-care bill that he described as creating a government-run insurance plan.
health.quote: the Senate cut back room deals for certain states and special interests in order to pass a government run insurance plan

energy.text: Rogers has opposed climate policies he says threaten coal jobs and has supported funding to modernize coal-fired power plants.
energy.quote: This funding will help ensure they can continue doing so for many years to come.

voting.text: He voted for the SAVE America Act and endorsed voter identification in every state.
voting.quote: The best way to safeguard the election of our American leaders is through basic voter identification in every state.

debt.text: Pillersdorf opposes proposed cuts to Medicare and says the district’s residents depend on the program.
debt.quote: if you support the ongoing proposed slashing of: Medicaid, Medicare, food stamps

health.text: Pillersdorf supports expanding health care access and opposes cuts to Medicaid and Medicare.
health.quote: I won’t stop fighting until every resident of the 5th District gets the coverage and care they deserve.

tax.text: In a 2018 questionnaire, he proposed eliminating the income tax, with a fair tax as an alternative.
tax.quote: A fair tax or get rid of it all together and implement a tariff on all goods that come to this county but get rid of the income tax altogether.

trade.text: He said he could support tariffs on all goods as part of replacing the income tax.
trade.quote: implement a tariff on all goods that come to this county but get rid of the income tax altogether.

debt.text: He says he will oppose Social Security benefit cuts and another increase in the retirement age.
debt.quote: I will oppose benefit cuts and another increase in the retirement age. Congress made this promise, and Congress must keep it.

immigration.text: He supports stronger border enforcement and faster lawful immigration while also emphasizing due process.
immigration.quote: I will support stronger border enforcement, faster lawful immigration, and firm action against cartels and traffickers—while protecting due process and America’s constitutional principles.

guns.text: In a 2018 questionnaire, he strongly disagreed that more restrictive gun control was needed for public safety.
guns.quote: More restrictive gun control is needed to protect public safety. Strongly Disagree

abortion.text: In a 2018 questionnaire, he said abortion should be allowed to save the mother’s life.
abortion.quote: Under what circumstances should abortion be allowed? To save the life of the mother.

health.text: In a 2018 questionnaire, he favored free and open markets for health coverage and criticized government regulation.
health.quote: I am all for free and open markets. We have never tried it before. We have always had regulations placed on it either by the Federal government or by the State.

tax.text: He calls for a universal health system funded by U.S. tax dollars and restoring health care funding.
tax.quote: we need a government run, universal, comprehensive healthcare system that is free at the point of service, paid for by U.S. tax dollars

wages.text: He supports stronger worker protections, a well-funded National Labor Relations Board, and renewed ability to form unions.
wages.quote: we need to re-gain the tools that would help us reclaim our share of the wealth: a vibrant National Labor Relations Board, stronger laws that protect worker’s rights, and renewed ability to form unions.

trade.text: He says tariffs raise prices and calls for legislation to control them.
trade.quote: Tariffs are increasing the price of everything; the rising costs of food and clothing are particularly worrisome.

debt.text: His action list supports pending legislation that includes the Social Security Expansion Act.
debt.quote: Support pending legislation to redistribute wealth back to workers

housing.text: He proposes federal support for constructing sustainable housing on suitable higher-ground sites.
housing.quote: RCC County level coalitions could forge a pathway to higher ground housing through an updated land ownership survey to identify suitable house sites; innovative partnerships to return land to local control; and construction of sustainable housing.

schools.text: He proposes tuition-free public education from early childhood through graduate, trade, or professional school.
schools.quote: It's time to pass legislation that guarantees free tuition to public schools from early childhood through graduate, trade, or professional school.

immigration.text: He calls for rolling back ICE funding and increasing accountability for federal immigration officers.
immigration.quote: Support legislation to unmask ICE and increase federal officer accountability

abortion.text: He calls for reviving the Women’s Health Protection Act, which would prohibit federal restrictions on reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: Revive H.R.3755, the Women’s Health Protection Act of 2021, which prohibits federal restrictions on women's reproductive healthcare

health.text: He supports a tax-funded, universal health system and calls for passage of Medicare for All.
health.quote: we need a government run, universal, comprehensive healthcare system that is free at the point of service, paid for by U.S. tax dollars, and provided to everyone regardless of their background.

energy.text: He proposes community coalitions that would include clean-energy production.
energy.quote: Other RCC coalitions could be formed to address disaster response, clean energy prodction, and other community needs.
